lines.text: Ezekiel must prophesy against Israel's shepherds, who eat the fat and wear the wool but do not feed the flock.
The shepherds ruled with violence and cruelty, and the scattered sheep became food for all the wild beasts.
The LORD will remove the shepherds, search for His flock Himself, and bring them from the countries to their fortress.
The LORD will judge between fat and lean sheep, save His flock, and appoint one shepherd, His servant Moses.
God will make a covenant of peace, send showers of blessing, and call the flock His people.
